gist_alignment: Stable HG002/NA24385 sample identifiers and the benchmark release are recorded.
GRCh38 reference and contig metadata are retained in the VCF header.
The VCF is explicitly paired with its intended benchmark-region BED.
VCF and BED coordinate conventions are distinguished.
The locally generated index is identified as a derived artifact with its generating command.
Checksums, software versions, record counts, variant summaries, and region-overlap results are linked.
limitations: This benchmark is not a general-purpose clinical callset.
Interpretation is limited to HG002, GRCh38, CMRG v1.00, and the accompanying benchmark regions.
The VCF and BED should be treated as a related package rather than independent files.
